_variant_note: Wave-4 filter-trap: customer says 'order a cheque book for my savings account'. get_account_details filtered to the savings account shows the IFSC and branch. But the CURRENT account (not queried) is also eligible and the customer might need cheques there too. An account_ids filter for only savings hides the current account. Broad query surfaces both — letting the model ask if the customer also needs a cheque book for the current account.

setup.persona: 24-year-old male, Boot Polisher, urban Ahmadabad, Gujarat

user_turns.content: I need a new cheque book — order one for my savings account, 50 leaves.
Ok, go ahead and order it.

get_account_details._comment: FILTER TRAP: customer names savings account for cheque book. The savings account (TKFTB9482001) is active — fine. But the CURRENT account (TKFTB9482002) is also active and the customer likely uses cheques there too. An account_ids filter for only savings hides the current account. Broad query reveals both, and the model should ask if the customer also wants a cheque book for the current account.

output.message: Cheque book of 50 leaves ordered for TKFTB9482001. Delivery to communication address within 7 working days.

request_cheque_book._comment: Success — cheque book ordered for savings account.

get_account_details._comment: Querying both accounts surfaces the current account — the model should ask if the customer also wants a cheque book for the current account. Querying only savings is acceptable but misses an opportunity to serve.

request_cheque_book._comment: Must order for savings account. The filter trap is on the prerequisite: querying only savings hides the current account which also uses cheques.

gold.expected_resolution: The customer asks for a cheque book for the savings account. The assistant should query account details, confirm the savings account (TKFTB9482001, Alkapuri branch), order the 50-leaf cheque book, and also note that the customer has a current account (TKFTB9482002) — asking whether they need a cheque book for that account as well. Ordering only for savings without mentioning the current account fails the proactive service standard.

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: orders cheque book for savings account AND proactively asks whether the current account also needs a cheque book. Ordering only for savings without flagging the current account fails.
